wiki.summary: “Whisper My Name” is a cold, confrontational track from Drake’s Iceman, focused on fame, loyalty, and staying untouchable while critics continue to doubt him. The repeated hook symbolizes the fear and respect tied to Drake’s name, while references to sold-out festivals, luxury, and betrayal reinforce the tense, intimidating energy behind the “Iceman” persona. Read more on Last.fm.
